purpose: Expose consequences of unqualified assumptions, not estimate BESS risk
geometry_source: Pinned Hazard r1 layout: base 0.30 m; enclosure height 2.90 m

entry_assumption.rule: For this experiment only, set critical entry equal to mounting base

battery_interpretations.status: Unselected stress interpretation: all integrated enclosure hardware replaced at first positive above-base depth
unproven_links: whole enclosure is economical replacement unit

battery_interpretations.status: Rejected as a selected mean: assumes uniformly distributed replacement value with height and independent wetted fraction

pcs_interpretation.status: Conditional T3 transfer candidate, not target-qualified
pcs_interpretation.water_condition: freshwater screening scenario only; no salinity or duration correction calibrated
pcs_interpretation.beyond_domain: no output rather than inheriting source-helper clamping

prohibited_uses: No midpoint, average, confidence band or probability mixture of battery interpretations
No map, annual metric, replacement recommendation or actual site prediction
No interpretation of zero direct overtopping as zero total Flood risk
No automatic inventory-wide use of one unit's local depth
